summary: Abaddon current interim engine/interaction decision after PR #516: Chaos Warp provides a real conditional resolved-stax answer, but no justified net-stronger cut. Corrected source costs Lost MV3 and Ruinous MV4; Lost additionally makes a Spawn from each fetched land put from library via seven canonical fetchlands, commander-zone cast and exile/graveyard casts. Otawara's channel must remain in hand; land-first zero availability was a biased policy artifact, so the registered reserve-channel policy reports 282/2000 approved baseline answer opportunities at T10 with 1297 aggregate land-drop forfeitures, vs 557-584/2000 for Warp challenger lists. This is neither stax frequency nor game performance. All candidates HOLD except retain Ruinous, no deck mutation or M6/7 certification.
